name: SOCKS Proxy CLI (socks-cli)
description: Installs socks-cli and configures shell aliases (sca/scd). Configure SOCKS_CLI_SOCKS_PROXY and SOCKS_CLI_AUTO_ACTIVATE via devcontainer feature options.

version.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit) of socks-cli to install

SOCKS_CLI_SOCKS_PROXY.description: SOCKS5 proxy host and port, for example 192.168.10.1:1080

SOCKS_CLI_AUTO_ACTIVATE.description: Set to any non-empty value to auto-activate socks-cli in new shells
